pairs: In salicibus in medio ejus suspendimus organa nostra:
By the willow trees, in their midst, we hung up our instruments.
those who led us into captivity questioned us about the words of the songs.
And those who carried us away said:
Hymnum cantate nobis de canticis Sion.
“Sing us a hymn from the songs of Zion.”
Quomodo cantabimus canticum Domini in terra aliena?
How can we sing a song of the Lord in a foreign land?
let my right hand be forgotten.
May my tongue adhere to my jaws,
if I do not remember you,
si non proposuero Jerusalem in principio lætitiæ meæ.
if I do not set Jerusalem first, as the beginning of my joy.
call to mind the sons of Edom,
exinanite usque ad fundamentum in ea.
O daughter of Babylon, have pity.
beatus qui retribuet tibi retributionem tuam quam retribuisti nobis.
Blessed is he who will repay you with your payment, which you have paid to us.
Blessed is he who will take hold of your little ones
et allidet parvulos tuos ad petram.
and dash them against the rock.
